title: stellaria sessiliflora var. japonica
intro: Stellaria sessiliflora var. japonica, commonly known as Starwort or Japanese Starwort, is a plant species in the Caryophyllaceae family, native to East Asia. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it useful in treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Stellaria sessiliflora var. japonica include its ability to reduce swelling, soothe skin irritations, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
